name: EPIC 220203067
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 11.0 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220203067 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 10.968146 (16th-84th percentiles 10.717416-11.351045), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220203067: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4555.4917 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220203067 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2243.027344 (16th-84th percentiles 2201.914062-2294.785156), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.08 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,243 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.86 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,555 K at its surface.
